data.one_liner: Generator for type-safe reactive forms based on data models.
data.what_it_does: Generates type-safe form classes, controls, and builders based on annotated model classes to work with the reactive_forms package.
use_when: You want to avoid boilerplate code when building forms with reactive_forms
You want compile-time safety and type-safe form values instead of handling dynamic maps
avoid_when: You prefer writing your forms manually without using code generation
You are not using the reactive_forms package
strengths: Eliminates boilerplate string identifiers and manual type casting for form values
Provides static type checks for form fields
Supports complex features like form arrays, nested form groups, and freezed models
weaknesses: Requires setting up build_runner and code generation steps
Tight coupling with the reactive_forms ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Requires adding build_runner, reactive_forms, and reactive_forms_annotations to your pubspec, and executing code generation via build_runner.
